quarterly_data.signal: General manager Zhao Lun (H1 2026 results briefing): H1 2026 revenue RMB 1,503.10 hundred million, up 873.64%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 776.05 hundred million and net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 787.93 hundred million; operating cash flow RMB 1,311.56 hundred million, up 2,985.64%. Senior vice president and CFO Huang Danyang said overseas revenue was 63.84% of main-business revenue in H1, and that contract liabilities fell to RMB 12.56 hundred million because orders behind Q1 contract liabilities were delivered and recognised in Q2.

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results briefing: CFO Huang Danyang said the global DRAM supply shortage will continue in H2 2026; general manager Zhao Lun said product contribution from the server segment increased in H1 on strong demand, that capacity utilisation stays high, and that as an IDM it can adjust product mix and output pace to market changes while keeping industry-cycle risk in view.
